android.desc:
Vehicle Motion Cues can help users reduce motion sickness. After obtaining data through multiple sensors on the phone, animated dots are displayed on the edge of the screen to simulate the vehicle's motion state, without interfering with the main display content, thereby reducing the sensory conflict between the visual experience when watching the phone and the actual driving experience of the vehicle, effectively alleviating motion sickness, and helping passengers get a more comfortable travel experience.

Why do people get motion sickness?
The vestibular system and the visual system responsible for state judgment in the human body have information gaps, which confuse the brain. The brain will mistakenly think that you are poisoned and hallucinating, so it will issue an instinctive reaction of self-protection such as emergency vomiting.

Warm reminder: Motion sickness problems vary from person to person. The software only provides physical help, so the effect varies from person to person. Please be aware of this.

quotes.story_title: Apple's weird anti-nausea dots cured my car sickness
